detail: Full summary: The content-scorer build session already recorded a systematic mutation pass: 'Fifteen targeted mutations were applied one at a time and all fifteen were caught by the intended test.' It independently hit the same obstacle Dave did — that the project's standard 'git stash push src/' check is a no-op on a NET-NEW module, because stashing deletes the file and every test dies on an import error, making a test that pins nothing look identical to one that pins everything. So the mutation claim exists and needs independent confirmation rather than a from-scratch pass.
